title: CAFE Calar Alto Fiber-fed Echelle spectrograph
what_was_studied: Design, commissioning and initial radial-velocity stability
numerical_result: The first configuration covered roughly 365 to 980 nm at resolving power near 70000 and targeted precision of a few tens of m/s
remaining_question: Which commissioning terms transferred to the later CAFE2 configuration?

title: CAFE2 an upgrade to the CAFE high-resolution spectrograph
what_was_studied: Thermal control, throughput, wavelength calibration, pipeline and on-sky commissioning
numerical_result: CAFE2 reported about 3 m/s ThAr stability and about 8 m/s on-sky precision in one night for spectra with S/N above 50
remaining_question: What is the multi-semester stability after maintenance and calibration changes?

title: CAFE observer information
what_was_studied: Current observing configuration and links to the reduction pipeline
numerical_result: The current page lists 407 to 925 nm and resolving power 62000 plus or minus 5000
remaining_question: The undated page does not establish a dated 2026 availability record
